fields.label: Presented
fields.value: FOSS Coin, home router & home lab

lead: I attended **India's first Omarchy Linux meetup** and presented at the **FOSS corner** — demoing my efforts on [FOSS Coin]([[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]]), walking through my GL.iNet home router and [home lab]([[homelab|home lab]]) setup, and talking through some of my other projects. It was a fun day, and I got to meet the organisers — including the CEO of LibreDevs — and chew over plenty of Linux and self-hosting topics with them.

content.content: I ran a FOSS corner at the meetup: a live demo of **FOSS Coin** — what it does, how the on-chain pieces fit together, and where the project is headed. I also walked people through my **GL.iNet home router and home lab** setup, the kind of gear and wiring that normally lives behind my desk and rarely gets an audience.

content.alt: Explaining my GL.iNet home router to the CEO of LibreDevs
content.caption: Walking the CEO of LibreDevs through my GL.iNet home router setup

content.content: One of the best conversations was with the **CEO of LibreDevs** — we dug into the router build, what runs on my home lab, and where self-hosted setups are headed. Nothing beats explaining your own gear to someone who immediately gets it.

The best part was the hallway track: meeting the organisers, trading notes on distros and tiling window managers, and discussing self-hosting topics with people who run their own infrastructure. First-of-its-kind energy — everyone there was early to something.
